fixes: Each StrictMode effect lifetime owns a fresh native intake and Back subscription.
Locale-only links replace the locale path and retain query/hash/selection/history; no atlas/book restoration is dispatched.
Back and newer user language/input cancel late navigation; native canGoBack=false is authoritative.
Canonical book close owns its animation, history and focus; immersive Back uses the real exit callback.
New entity/section entries return to the locale homepage and drop stale book/immersive Back markers without changing unrelated state.
Warm section destinations request their deferred scroll target.
Controlled image delivery uses selected canonical originals, avoiding optimized derivatives absent from bundled assets.
correction: Earlier review speculated a native direct-article bootstrap deadlock. Controlled native builds disable that route predicate; no such runtime failure is claimed and unnecessary loader changes were removed.
